title: Rewards, returns and values: agent evaluation

slides.title: Immediate reward
slides.text: R: a reward received after one step of interaction with an environment.
slides.transcript: A reward is numerical feedback from one step. It does not describe the entire future of a trajectory.

slides.title: Discounted return
slides.text: G_t = R_(t+1) + gamma R_(t+2) + gamma^2 R_(t+3) + ... . Return combines future rewards.
slides.transcript: The return is the sum of future rewards weighted by powers of the discount factor gamma.

slides.title: State value
slides.text: v(s) = E[G_t | S_t = s]. Value is the expected return from a state.
slides.transcript: We average returns over possible futures. This expected return is the state value.
